description: Retry child construction indefinitely when a candidate fails validation.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The supplied vectors are a population.; fitness_evaluation: objective ranks candidates by their absolute gene sum.; selection: The best eight candidates become parents.; mutation: make_child changes a copied parent's random gene.; replacement: evolve returns parents and the generated offspring as the next cohort.. Negative-role rationale: Children come from one parent, and the unbounded retry is a child-validity loop rather than a terminating EA process. Safety behavior: valid requires a negative sum, but generated genes are nonnegative, so make_child retries forever for every selected parent. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats hard unbounded-loop or recursion-without-base findings as UNSAFE.
